parent_objective: implement no-training local boundary miner that converts temporal action sensitivity into closed-loop outcome-critical rows

public_gates: runner starts from source-balanced M719 temporal action-sensitive rows
runner reruns scenarios in memory rather than reconstructing hidden tensors from CSV only
local obstacle timing lateral offset footprint boundary slack and surprise fault timing perturbations are logged
normal-history retention is required before accepting outcome-critical rows
accepted rows require first action distance >= 0.015 and success drop or margin gap >= 0.02
source diversity across seeds and fault families is reported
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim action-only rows are source-positive outcome rows
do not mutate actor observations with hidden fault labels or oracle values
do not accept rows where normal history already fails
do not use malformed obstacle placement or impossible scenario mutation as evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_action_to_outcome: implement boundary mining that tests whether temporal action deltas affect closed-loop margin
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a no-training miner over source-balanced M719 action-sensitive rows with local boundary perturbations and outcome gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic data wave only; source export objective design PPO and promotion remain blocked unless outcome-critical rows pass diversity and retention gates
stop_condition: stop if accepted rows are below the registered threshold
stop if accepted rows are dominated by one seed or one fault family
stop if normal-history failures dominate local perturbations
stop if sentinel rows become positive at high rate
stop if actor checksum or input contract changes
fallback_plan: if temporal outcome rows are source-diverse, audit them before source export or objective design
if rows stay action-only, pivot to sequence or actor-head objective design only as action-level diagnostics
if current single-track proxy faults are insufficient, design a four-wheel or explicit-yaw-disturbance fidelity branch
if source diversity is weak, rerun coverage with source-balanced max-pair allocation before training
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M721 opens temporal action-boundary outcome mining branch after M720 temporal_action_only audit

hypothesis: A source-balanced no-training local boundary miner can convert M719 temporal command-history action deltas into outcome-critical clearance or success gaps without changing actor inputs or training.
success_criteria: M722 implements a reusable temporal action-boundary outcome miner
M722 writes source rows candidate variants intervention rollouts accepted rows rejected rows summaries and milestone documentation
accepted rows require normal-history viability and temporal mismatch outcome degradation
source diversity and sentinel false-positive rates are reported
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: runner treats M719 action-only rows as source-positive without outcome gaps
runner accepts rows where normal history already fails
runner omits source diversity or sentinel false-positive reporting
runner starts optimizer training PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M722 may only classify the no-training boundary mining result. It must not admit source export, actor update, PPO, or promotion until an audit reviews source diversity, normal-history retention, and sentinel false positives.
